CLM-COMPLETION-PARTNER inverts the sampling-interval mix caveat (it claims the Wilson interval also covers a changing country mix). AOV claims omit delivered-only and net-of-refunds wording in caveats; CLM-TEST-CHANNEL-AOV states an all-orders population while n is delivered-only.
